results.invariant: A Run cannot become completed before its settled checkpoint commits.
At-least-once delivery does not execute the same command twice.
A released or recovered old worker cannot reacquire an obsolete fence.
A lost acknowledgement causes safe replay rather than event loss.
Corrupt durable events are rejected rather than silently skipped.
A temporary object-store outage remains retryable and does not expose credentials.
Checkpoint integrity and compare-and-swap fencing survive cold recovery.
Exactly one terminal Run outcome wins a cancel/complete race.
A superseded dispatcher cannot start external work.
Expired ownership is reconciled only after the orphan runtime is terminated.
Rewind restores the explicit committed bases, supersedes the old projection, and creates one idempotent replacement Run.
A completed Run's content-verified Review Bundle cannot be updated or deleted.
